camel_example: aliyun alidns DescribeDomainInfo --region cn-hangzhou --NeedDetailAttributes true --DomainName 'example.com' --Lang en
description_en: Queries information about a specified domain name
description_zh: 根据传入参数查询指定域名的信息
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-domain-info --lang en --domain-name example.com --need-detail-attributes true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainInfo

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The domain name. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2357286.html to obtain the domain name
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return detailed attributes of the domain name. Valid values:

true

false

The default value is false.

If you set this parameter to true, the response includes the following parameters: lineType, minTtl, recordLineTreeJson, recordLines, lineCode, lineDisplayName, lineName, regionLines, and slaveDns
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回域名详细的属性，取值范围：
true：
false 

默认值：false，不需要细节属性。

当值为true时，则返回以下数据：lineType、minTtl、recordLineTreeJson、recordLines、lineCode、lineDisplayName、lineName、regionLines、slaveDns
parameters.name: need_detail_attributes

AliDomain.description_en: Indicates whether the domain name was registered with Alibaba Cloud
AliDomain.description_zh: 是否为阿里云万网域名

AvailableTtl.description_en: The list of available Time to Live (TTL) values for the domain name. This parameter is not returned by default. To return this parameter, set NeedDetailAttributes to true
AvailableTtl.description_zh: 域名当前可用TTL列表。默认不返回，需要设置NeedDetailAttributes=true

items.description_en: A string that contains an array of available TTL values

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the domain name was created

DnsServer.description_en: The list of DNS servers for the domain name
DnsServer.description_zh: 域名在解析系统中的DNS列表

items.description_en: A string that contains an array of DNS servers

DomainId.description_en: The ID of the domain name

DomainLoggingSwitchStatus.description_en: The status of the logging feature
DomainLoggingSwitchStatus.example:
CLOSE：关闭状态
OPEN：开启状态

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the domain name group

GroupName.description_en: The name of the domain name group

InBlackHole.description_en: Indicates whether blackhole filtering is activated for the domain name

InClean.description_en: Indicates whether the domain name is being scrubbed

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud DNS instance

LineType.description_en: The type of the DNS request source line
LineType.description_zh: 解析请求来源线路类型

PunyCode.description_en: The Punycode for the Chinese domain name
PunyCode.description_zh: 只针对中文域名返回punycode码

RecordLineTreeJson.description_en: The list of DNS request source lines in a tree structure
RecordLineTreeJson.description_zh: 树形化解析请求来源线路列表

RecordLine.description_en: The list of DNS request source lines
RecordLine.description_zh: 解析请求来源线路数据列表

FatherCode.description_en: The code of the parent line. This parameter is empty if no parent line exists
FatherCode.description_zh: 父线路Code，如果没有则为空

LineCode.description_en: The code of the child line

LineDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the parent line

LineName.description_en: The display name of the child line

RegionLines.description_en: Indicates whether the line is a regional line

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

SlaveDns.description_en: Indicates whether secondary DNS is supported

SubDomain.description_en:
Indicates whether the queried domain is a hosted subdomain. Valid values:

true

false
SubDomain.description_zh:
查询的 domain 是否是托管的子域名。
取值：
true
false

VersionCode.description_en:
The edition ID of Alibaba Cloud DNS. Valid values:

version_enterprise_advanced: Ultimate Edition

version_personal: Personal Edition

mianfei: Free Edition
VersionCode.description_zh:
云解析版本ID。取值范围：
version_enterprise_advanced：企业旗舰版
version_personal 个人版
mianfei：免费版

VersionName.description_en: The name of the Alibaba Cloud DNS edition
